chapter: Chicago, Lee Collins and the road
title: Wishing they had documented every musician
summary: Danny regrets not recording the old musicians and Milt remarks on the experience of sitting with him.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: Boy, if we would have been thinking, the way things have changed, we could have documented damn near every musician in this country.
We just wouldn't have thought about it. I got the first idea when that cat (?) took Big-Eye Louis' picture. He was the ...(?). giving hell. Who was the cat who used to write for Esquire? Miller?
Miller, yeah. Oh, that was Miller. Paul...
[SMITTY AND MILT HINTON CHAT AS DANNY BARKER LEAVES ROOM]
It's a great experience to sit with a man like Danny Barker.
